name: Polynomial Minimum Disguise
description: Replaced the modular arithmetic drift formula with a custom 2-variable polynomial system (T and R) that evaluates to exactly 7 for all valid (unequal) frequency pairs, and strictly greater than 7 for all invalid (equal) pairs. The global target W = 7m can therefore only be achieved if every edge is unequal. This breaks the model's ability to easily map the constraint to a binary inequality via truth table recognition, forcing it to either mathematically prove the minimum or fall back to naive exponential search which will TLE.
